outcome: strategies used to minimize urine leakage
cohort: The study participants were 828 female CrossFit practitioners who responded to an online questionnaire.
finding: Women with higher urinary incontinence (UI) scores reported a greater impact on quality of life (QoL), and a history of two or more gestations and sexual dysfunction or pelvic organ prolapse increased the risk of a high UI impact on QoL.
cross-section timing: The study collected data from female CrossFit practitioners at a single point in time via an online survey.
